greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNdodana, nelikaMoya oyingcwele. Amen. Makube luxolo lwaluYesu Kristu oluhlala nawe namhlanje nakwezi ntsuku zonke zobomi benu.

homily:
Cinga ngesandla esibambe ikhibhodi ebusuku, imbonakalo yomfana ogoba phezu kwekhowudi eyakhayo, elindela ukuba ifestile elandelayo ivuleke kwisikrini sakhe esikhanyayo. Benjamin Vo wayengumfana owayehlala ejonge kweli hlabathi ngamehlo okuba ngumakhi, umntu owayeqonda kakuhle ukuba izinto ezincinci zakha iinkqubo ezinkulu—nokuba yayikukubhala imidlalo yakhe kwi-GitHub, okanye ukuyila loo mbono omnandi wendiza ayibiza ngokuba yi-'con chim airlines' eyayimenza agcigcise futhi amomotheke ngalo lonke ixesha ethetha ngayo nobawo wakhe. Wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo yezibalo nolwazi lwezixhobo zekhompyutha, kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, wayeneentliziyo eyayazi ukuba kuthetha ukuthini ukunika konke ngaphandle kokubala.

KwiNcwadi kaPawulos kwabaseFilipi namhlanje, uPawulos usixelela amazwi akhanyayo: 'Ndinamandla ezinto zonke kulowo undomelezayo.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UPawulos akathethi ngamandla asuka kwiimfazwe zeli hlabathi okanye kwiimvavanyo zobuchule. Uthetha ngamandla okuqhubeka xa yonke into ibonakala ingenakwenzeka, amandla okuphila nokuba sezintlungwini okanye ekuphumeleleni ngaphandle kokuba umphefumlo wakho uwe. UBen wayenaleyo mfanekiso entliziyweni yakhe. Khumbula lowo mzuzu apho uBen, eneminyaka elishumi elinesihlanu, waxelela abazali bakhe ukuba wayezimisele ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yasebhange yakhe encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe zizifo ezimbini. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube, akazange ayikhuphule imali leyo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe: umntwana owayeselula kodwa onentliziyo enkulu eyayifuna ukunceda wonke umntu ngaphandle kokucingela yena, umntwana owayengafihli lutho xa kuthethwa ngokuthanda.

Kodwa masiyimele inyaniso namhlanje ngaphambi kokuba siye phambili. Alan noThao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu, zikushiya ungazi nokuba ume ngaphi. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kwesitulo sikaBen okanye ukungaphulaphuli kwakhe amabanga ayethethwa nguyise kubangela isikhewu esingazalisekiyo. Kukho amaxesha apho ukuziva usodwa kuhlasela ngaphandle kwesaziso, kwaye umthwalo wokulahlekelwa uba nzima kakhulu ukuba ungathwalwa. Mamela le nyaniso namhlanje, mhlawumbi ngendlela odinga ngayo ukuyiva ngoku: uThixo akamlibalanga uBen, kwaye akakubalelanga nani. Kwizinto ezenzekayo ebudeni bokugula kwabantwana, abazali abaninzi bazithwala ngokwabo umthwalo onzima kakhulu wokuzisola: 'Ngaba kukhona endinokukwenza ngcono? Ngaba ndiphosile?' Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu usixelela ngamazwi anzulu malunga nokuthembeka: 'Lowo uthembekileyo ezintweni ezincinci uthembekile nasezintweni ezinkulu.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UYesu akathethi kuphela ngezimali okanye ngobutyebi beli hlabathi. Uthetha ngendlela esiphila ngayo ngobubele nangokunyaniseka kwimizuzu yethu yonke. UBen wayengumfana owayethembekile kuzo zonke izinto ezincinci zobomi—ekulaleleni abazali bakhe, ekuboniseni uncumo olungagungqiyo, nasekuphatheni abo bamngqongileyo ngentlonipho enkulu. UBen akazange azame ukuba mkhulu ngamagama; waba mkhulu ngezandla ezazifuna ukwakha izinto ezintle nabantu ababesecaleni kwakhe. Xa uYesu ethetha ngokungakwazi ukukhonza amakhosi amabini, uBen wayeyazi ukuba wayekhonza Bani. Wayezinikele kuloo thando lukhulu lwezulu.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
standing_petitions: Ukuze uBenjamin Vo kunye nabo bonke abasehlabathini abasishiyeyo baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu, sikhuleka kuwe.
Ukuze bonke abasentslungwini nabazileyo bafumane intuthuzelo netyhefu ethembekileyo evela kuThixo, sikhuleka kuwe.

readings.label: Ukufundwa kokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana: Ndiyavuya kakhulu eNkosini ukuba ngoku ekugqibeleni nivusile ukundikhathalela kwenu. Nasisuke nazixhalabisa ngam, kodwa nabangelwa kukuba beningenamathuba. Andithethi nje ngenxa yokuswela, kuba ndifundile ukuzanelisa kuyo nayiphi na imeko endikuyo. Ndiyakwazi ukuphila kwimeko ephantsi; ndiyakwazi ukuphila nasemabaleni. Kuzo zonke iimeko nakuzo zonke izinto ndifundile imfihlelo yokuhlutha nokulamba, yokuphila ngobuninzi nasekusweleni. Ndinamandla ezinto zonke kulowo undomelezayo. Noko ke kwakubi kuhle ukuba nabelane ngenxaxheba osizi lwam. Nina baseFilipi niyazi ukuba ekuqaleni kweVangeli, oko ndaphumayo eMakedoniya, akukho bandla lanyamezela nam ngendlela yokupha nokwamkela, inguwe nina wedwa. Kuba naseTesalonika nendithumelela izinto zezidingo zam, kungekhona kanye kodwa kwaba kanye nangaphezulu. Akukho kuthi ndifuna isipho; ndifuna isiqhamo esandisa isabelo senu. Ndifumene konke ngokupheleleyo, ndize ndibe nokuphuphumayo. Ndihluthe kakhulu ngokuba ndamkele kuEpafrodito izinto ezithunyelwe ninu, “izingqangi zevumba elimnandi,” umnikelo owamkelekileyo, omuhle kuThixo. UThixo wam uya kukubonelela konke okunikelayo ngokobutyebi bakhe obuzukileyo kuKristu Yesu.

readings.label: IHubo lokuphendula
readings.text: Ubusisiwe umntu owoyika uYehova, owonwabela kakhulu imiyalelo yakhe. Inzala yakhe iya kuba namandla emhlabeni; isizukulwana esithembekileyo siya kusiswa. Kuhle kumntu onobubele obolekayo, olawula imicimbi yakhe ngobulungisa; akasayi kuze anyikikiswe; olungileyo uya kukhunjulwa ngonaphakade. Intliziyo yakhe iqinisekile; akoyiki. Upha ngokwaneleyo kwabahluphekayo; ubulungisa bakhe buya kuhlala ngonaphakade; uphondo lwakhe luya kuphakanyiswa ngobuqaqawuli.

readings.label: Ivangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kubafundi bakhe: “Ndithi kuni, zenzeleni abahlobo ngobutyebi obungekho sikweni, ukuze xa buphelayo, nifumane ukwamkelwa ezindlini ezingunaphakade. Lowo uthembekileyo ezintweni ezincinci uthembekile nasezintweni ezinkulu; naye ongenakulungela ezintweni ezincinci, akanakulungela nasezintweni ezinkulu. Ukuba ngoko anithembekanga ngobutyebi obungekho sikweni, ngubani oya kuninika ubutyebi benyaniso? Kwaye ukuba anithembekanga ngento yomunye, ngubani oya kuninika eyenu? Akukho mkhonzi unokukhonza amakhosi amabini; kuba uya kuthi athathe elinye athande elinye, okanye anamathele elinye ade ajonge phantsi elinye. Aninakumkhonza uThixo noMammon.” Ab Pharisees, ababehamba ngemali, bakuva zonke ezi zinto, bamgxeka. Wathi kubo: “Nina nizigwebela phambi kwabantu, kodwa uThixo uyazazi iintliziyo zenu; kuba into ephakanyiswayo ngabantu iyinto enye eyichasisayo phambi kukaThixo.”

spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukho kwiSakramente eliCilekileyo leAltare. Ndikuthanda ngaphezu kwezinto zonke, kwaye ndifuna ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngendlela yokomoya. Ndiyamkela njengokuba sele ukhona, kwaye ndidibene nawe ngokuphelele; musa ukuvumela ukuba ndahlukane nawe kuze kube nini na. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo angahlala ekhanyisa indlela yenu ngoxolo lwakhe olungasithethekiyo. Hamba ngoxolo lweNkosi.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!
